correctness.rationale: PASS is for repairs/2/RESULT.md. In the frozen wording the claim at line 33 about critical values is false if read for the ordinary radius map on distinct-vertex triangles: its derivative never vanishes. Indeed the half-sum map is a local diffeomorphism, q' vanishes only at 0 and π/2 modulo π, and any critical triple of half-sums repeats a value, forcing two original angles to coincide modulo 2π. The repair distinguishes the smooth full-torus extension, which has the stated two interior critical values, from the ordinary nondegenerate domain; the random law is unchanged because coincident vertices have probability zero. Chord factors cancel against four times the area after the affine map from the circle, and the integer half-sum map in doubled coordinates is an onto finite covering, preserving normalized Haar in the pushforward. Transforming an arcsine variable yields the displayed Mellin and log-convolution laws. I reconstructed the localized saddle integral: integrating first in w=B(y²+z²) gives π/B times a smooth angularly averaged Jacobian in (x,w), evaluated at w=s+Ax². A smooth extension across w=0 shows the only first-order nonsmooth contribution is the missing x interval of length 2√(-s/A) for s<0 with weight 1+O(|x|+|s|); its error is O(|s|). At b, A=bd/(2a²) and B=d/(2b); reversed signs at a give A=ad/(2b²), B=d/(2a). Three saddles and density π⁻³ give both coefficients and their sides; the endpoint ellipsoid volume gives the two tail constants. The orthogonal cosine expansion of log q gives one-factor variance Li₂(ρ²)/2, hence the total variance and strictly invertible axis ratio. Scale comes from exp(L)=m/(1−ρ²). The frozen checker was inspected, not executed; it supplies finite numerical diagnostics, not the cusp proof.

value.rationale: The circumradius is a natural scalar invariant of three boundary samples. The shared-angle factors turn out to be independent, giving an exact law with two distinct, quantifiable non-smooth transitions rather than only simulation or moments. Population recovery of an ellipse from two statistics of this same invariant is a meaningful inverse result. These contributions survive verbatim in the repaired result; there is no claim of novelty for the extrema or the elementary Fourier/dilogarithm calculation in isolation.
residual_risks: The inversion is at the population level only, without sample-error or stability bounds.
